create_model_chat_blueprint: create a ModelChatBlueprint subclass to run human-to-model conversations with turn annotations and evaluation
create_image_chat_blueprint: create a ModelImageChatBlueprint subclass to run human-to-model conversations with image context on the first turn
configure_blueprint_args: configure BaseModelChatBlueprintArgs dataclass fields to set num_turns, model_opt_path, chat_data_folder, and annotation settings
get_shared_models: call _get_shared_models on a blueprint to load bot agents from a YAML model_opts file via TurkLikeAgent
review_conversations_needed: review the conversations_needed_string format like modelA:50,modelB:20 to set per-model conversation quotas
